facts.fact: 2024 年 10 月 31 日万圣夜，男主花好几天准备过冬
facts.anchor: All Hallows’ Eve. I’ve spent most of the past few days getting ready for winter.

facts.fact: 他为想象中的 Caroline 摆两份餐具、倒两杯酒、看见椅背上的外套
facts.anchor: And it was pleasant, cooking for two; setting two plates at the table

facts.fact: 他意识到自己要的独处其实只是想逃离她
facts.anchor: He’d thought he wanted to be alone, but now he realised he’d simply wanted to escape her.

facts.fact: 短信来自一个他不认识的号码
facts.anchor: from a number he did not recognise

facts.fact: 第三条短信语气突变：威胁（我知道你在哪里、知道你做了什么）
facts.anchor: You think you can hide away in here. I know where you are. I know what you did.

facts.fact: 第四条短信只有「我要来了」
他把手机用力扔进松林的黑暗里
facts.anchor: he threw it as hard as he could into the darkness of the pines

facts.fact: Arthur 日记写：万圣夜死者饥饿归来
facts.anchor: On All Hallows’ Eve, the dead rise hungry.
